title: Species builds
kicker: Power and builds · level up and power
hook: **WIP:** species you field grow their own aptitude lean over time — you can override; changing your mind costs a priced respec.

blindSpots.meaning: Not a finished player loop yet.
Aptitude tilt that grows on a species line from fielding it — separate from one specimen’s XP.
You can force a different face; respec is priced so the lean still means something.
Enemies can show adaptive builds after fights — content, not a class you pick.

alsoTrue: Commander free-build aptitudes already ship thin — see [aptitudes](aptitudes).
Play without waiting on species lean.

sections.title: What it will be
paras: Field a species and watch its lean drift toward how you used it.
Override when you need another face; pay the respec friction.

sections.title: What you do today
paras: Raise specimens; treat missing species-lean UI as unfinished.

doTitle: What you do while it is WIP
doSteps: Keep fielding the species you care about.
Use commander aptitudes for side-wide lean now.

mixUps.a: No. You still have no class. This is species lean.

mixUps.q: Does every specimen share one lean?
mixUps.a: Design is per species line you field, not one global class.

mixUps.q: Can Zomboss use this against me?
mixUps.a: Adaptive enemy patterns are content — yes, as opposing builds.
